figures.title: One wide head versus eight narrow heads
figures.caption: Splitting d_model = 512 into eight heads of d_head = 64 gives each head its own softmax. The wide head must divide one unit of mass between the previous token and the antecedent, 0.497 and 0.458; the split heads each put 0.984 on their relation. The eight 64-vectors concatenate into a 512-vector and W_O maps it back to the residual stream. Parameters are unchanged: 8 × 512 × 64 = 512 × 512 = 262,144 per projection, 4 × 262,144 = 1,048,576 attention weights.
figures.alt: Two aligned panels. The left panel, one head of width 512, lists Q, K and V as 512 by 512 matrices, one softmax over the sequence, two relations sharing the mass at 0.497 and 0.458, one 512-vector output, and a 512 by 512 W_O. The right panel, eight heads of width 64, lists Q_h, K_h and V_h as 512 by 64 matrices, eight independent softmaxes, head 1 putting 0.984 on the previous token, head 2 putting 0.984 on the antecedent, eight 64-vector outputs, and a 512-vector concatenation followed by W_O. The parameter note says 8 × 512 × 64 = 262,144 per projection either way.

panels.title: Eight heads, width 64
panels.note: Parameters: 8 × 512 × 64 = 262,144 per projection; 4 × 262,144 = 1,048,576 attention weights either way.

steps.label: Start with one 512-wide head and one softmax.
Split d_model = 512 into eight heads of d_head = 64.
Each head runs its own softmax over the sequence.
Head 1 puts 0.984 on the previous token; head 2 puts 0.984 on the antecedent.
W_O maps the concatenation back into the residual stream.

figures.title: What survives head pruning
figures.caption: The sparse model kept 14 of 48 encoder self-attention heads, 31 of 48 decoder self-attention heads, and 30 of 48 decoder-encoder heads. The last bar is the 48-head budget, not a pruned model. Most encoder layers tolerated losing a large share of heads with a small BLEU change; the decoder was less prunable.
figures.alt: Four horizontal bars. Encoder self-attention: 14 of 48. Decoder self-attention: 31 of 48. Decoder-encoder attention: 30 of 48. A reference bar shows the 48-head budget.

data.note: Voita et al. 2019 kept these heads in their sparse model after L0 head gating. The last bar is the budget, not a pruned model.

sources.note: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need; the eight-head split, 512/64 widths, and W_O.
Voita et al., Analyzing Multi-Head Self-Attention; the 14/31/30 of 48 kept heads.
